subject.title: fix(ci): keep action pin comments stable

question: Should the workflow/security owner approve the exact tag annotations, including the untagged Blacksmith-action exception, as the repository’s canonical Zizmor-compatible pin metadata?
rationale: The diff is broad but execution-neutral, while protected labels require an explicit owner decision on security-sensitive workflow metadata and on the one deliberate non-tag exception.

options.title: Approve exact annotations
